capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Express impatience and ask for details.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factors.

Return the verification outcome.

steps.text: Verification के लिए धन्यवाद Amit sir। मैं आपके order का status check कर रहा हूँ।

steps.purpose: Retrieve the current fulfilment status and details of the order.
Return the order details.
Share the basic order details and current status with the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output.
steps.text: Sir, आपका washing machine का prepaid order 7 दिन पहले place हुआ था, और वो अभी shipped status में दिख रहा है।
steps.planner_rationale: State facts exactly as retrieved from lookup_order without any unsupported guarantees.

steps.purpose: Point out the delay and ask for the current location.
steps.text: हाँ तो 5 दिन का promise था ना? अभी तक कहाँ अटका है?

steps.purpose: Inform the customer that courier tracking is being checked.
steps.text: मैं courier partner का track record check करता हूँ, एक minute hold कीजिए।

steps.purpose: Retrieve courier scan history to find the exact delivery exception.
Return the tracking details and exception.
Explain the delivery exception based on the tracking result.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output.
steps.text: Sir, courier update के हिसाब से आपका address unreachable mark किया गया है, इसलिए delivery नहीं हो पाई।
steps.planner_rationale: Explain the exception verbatim from the track_shipment result.

steps.purpose: React with frustration to the unreachable status.
steps.text: Address unreachable? ये क्या नाटक है! मैं तो पूरा दिन घर पर ही था। उन्होंने call भी नहीं किया।

steps.purpose: Empathize with the customer and propose raising a complaint.
steps.text: मैं आपकी परेशानी समझ सकता हूँ sir। मैं courier team के पास एक complaint raise कर देता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Attempt to raise a complaint for non-delivery.
Return the rejection of the complaint.
Explain the tool failure and the reason for rejection.
steps.expected_behavior: Resume the workflow correctly after recoverable failures.
steps.text: Sir, system ने 'not delivered' reason accept नहीं किया क्योंकि order अभी transit में है।
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the tool failure and explain the rejection without inventing facts.

steps.purpose: Ask for an alternative solution.
steps.text: तो अब क्या करना होगा? मुझे मेरा order जल्दी चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Propose an alternative solution by raising a delayed complaint.
steps.text: मैं इस complaint को 'delayed' reason के under raise कर रहा हूँ। इससे issue जल्दी escalate होगा।

steps.purpose: Attempt to raise the complaint again using the 'delayed' reason.
Return the successful creation of the complaint.
Confirm the successful creation of the complaint and share the ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output.
steps.text: Sir, complaint successfully raise हो गई है। आपका complaint ID CMP-88776 है।
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the generated complaint ID exactly as returned.

steps.purpose: Ask for the resolution timeline.
steps.text: ठीक है। इसका resolution आने में कितना time लगेगा?

steps.purpose: Share the resolution timeline.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response entirely on the returned tool output.
steps.text: इस complaint का resolution 2 दिन में मिल जाएगा sir।
steps.planner_rationale: State the resolution days exactly as returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Accept the resolution and end the call.
steps.text: Okay, मैं 2 दिन wait कर लेता हूँ। Bye.

However, it violates the variant's negative constraint in e24 by inventing an unsupported forward guarantee that the 'delayed' reason will escalate the issue quickly.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e24, the assistant claims that raising the complaint under the 'delayed' reason will escalate the issue quickly ('इससे issue जल्दी escalate होगा'). This is an unsupported forward guarantee not backed by any tool output, violating the Tool Output Grounding variant's strict constraints.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the claim about the issue escalating quickly. The assistant should simply state that they are trying to raise the complaint under the 'delayed' reason instead.

verifications.summary: The conversation accurately reflects the outbound delivery exception scenario and the hurried professional persona. The workflow recovery variant is perfectly executed after a tool rejection. However, the assistant invents an unsupported forward guarantee when proposing an alternative complaint reason, violating the grounding constraints. A minor surface repair is needed to remove this hallucination.

variant_findings.reason: The agent encounters a valid tool rejection when attempting to use the 'not_delivered' reason, correctly informs the user of the system rejection without inventing a cause, and successfully recovers by using the 'delayed' reason instead.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Workflow Recovery After Failure

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds most of its responses heavily in the tool outputs (e.g., stating the exact status, exception, complaint ID, and resolution days). However, it violates the negative constraint of the variant in e24 by making an unsupported forward guarantee.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e24, the assistant claims 'इससे issue जल्दी escalate होगा' (this will escalate the issue faster). This is a forward guarantee about the post-call process that is not supported by any tool output, directly violating the negative constraints of the Tool Output Grounding variant.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the unsupported claim 'इससे issue जल्दी escalate होगा।' from the assistant's utterance so that it only states the action being taken.

verifications.summary: The conversation correctly follows the outbound delivery exception workflow, effectively demonstrating workflow recovery after a tool rejection.
